policy.truth: Frozen sealed D0 and FINAL rows/product classifications unchanged. No new grader call, source/native acquisition or re-review is used.
policy.matching: Unchanged match_claims on original machine, manual and machine+manual claims. No missing fields/expected values or broad states filled from the oracle.
policy.strict_vs_product: Strict rejection includes scope/expectation/unit mismatches. Such rejection alone is not a confirmed product false alarm; unmapped claims remain product U. Exact descriptor matches to sealed P rows concretely contradict failure claims.
policy.failure_denominator: Only transported machine/manual failure claims enter eligible failure metrics. non_failure_claims are excluded from FP/U failure denominators; ineligible/qualitative findings are retained separately as U.
policy.cluster_credit: Exact fixed-row-supported cluster detection requires at least one original matched confirmed product F row. Related unasserted original concerns are preserved as qualitative cluster linkage, without repairing descriptors or awarding extra row/cluster discovery credit.
policy.rates: Classical FPR is N/A: no complete TN universe. Report conditional false discovery FP/(TP+FP), unknown-inclusive bounds and all denominators. Zero denominator is N/A.
policy.repair: Compare all immutable public P1/P2 row identities. Heldout H1 FINAL quality stays separate and has no D0 repair denominator.

confirmed_D0_clusters.description: On same-mounted iOS caller replacement, channel seed values are not fully restored: Room tone remains unmuted in P1/P2 and Music bed remains5 in P2. Displayed load/headroom/warning and P2 increment eligibility consequently reflect initial channel values. New caller context, live limit and mode do update. Exact underlying SwiftUI mechanism not isolated.
confirmed_D0_clusters.independence: One observed behavioral cluster with repeated states/platform fixtures; repeated row manifestations are not separate experiments.
